declarations.name: AuiLiveAnnouncer
declarations.description: Screen-reader announcements through the shared live regions (inside an open modal dialog when there is one).

methods.name: announce
methods.signature: announce(message: string, politeness?: Politeness | undefined): void
methods.description: Announce a message (text only, never parsed as HTML). No-op on the server.

declarations.name: AuiFocusTrap
declarations.description:
Keep keyboard focus inside the host while enabled: `
...
` or `[auiFocusTrap]="editing()"`. Focus moves in on activation and returns on deactivation.

inputs.name: auiFocusTrap
inputs.description: Whether the trap is active (default true; an empty attribute counts as true).

inputs.name: restoreFocus
inputs.description: Return focus to the previously focused element on deactivation (default true).

declarations.name: AuiFocusRestore
declarations.description:
Return focus to the element that was focused when the host appeared, when the host is
destroyed: `@if (editing) { <section auiFocusRestore>...</section> }`.

declarations.name: AuiRovingTabindex
declarations.description:
Roving tabindex (WAI-ARIA APG) over the host's items: one item in the tab sequence,
arrow keys move between items, Home/End jump, disabled items are skipped.
`<div role="toolbar" auiRovingTabindex="[data-item]" orientation="horizontal">`.

inputs.name: auiRovingTabindex
inputs.description: CSS selector of the items inside the host (default: direct children).

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Which arrow keys move between items: 'vertical', 'horizontal', or 'both' (default 'vertical').

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: Wrap from the last item to the first and back (default true).

inputs.name: typeahead
inputs.description: Typing characters moves to the next item whose text starts with them (default false).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Overrides the configured direction (RTL mirrors horizontal arrows).

outputs.name: activated
outputs.description: An item became active through the keyboard.

methods.name: setActive
methods.signature: setActive(index: number, focus?: boolean | undefined): void
methods.description: Make an item the active one (and optionally focus it).

declarations.name: AuiHotkey
declarations.description:
Keyboard shortcut on the host (or the document with `hotkeyScope="document"`):
`<div auiHotkey="Mod+K" (hotkey)="openSearch()">`. "Mod" is Meta on Apple platforms
and Control elsewhere. The matching keydown is prevented.

inputs.name: auiHotkey
inputs.description: Key combination such as "Mod+K", "Shift+?", or "Escape" ("Mod" is Meta on Apple platforms, Control elsewhere).

inputs.name: hotkeyScope
inputs.description: Listen on the host only ('element', default) or anywhere in the document ('document'); read once when the host renders.

outputs.name: hotkey
outputs.description: The combination was pressed (its default action is prevented).
